basis:
Rank every ASAP7 record under results/physical_abi3/asap7 by measured Fmax.

Nothing here is estimated.  Every field is copied from a record a run wrote:
``design.fmax_hz`` (ORFS ``finish__timing__fmax`` for a routed record, OpenSTA
``1/(period - WNS)`` for a pre-layout one), ``design.closed`` and the signal
integrity counts that decide it, and ``target_clock_period_ns``.

``target_headroom`` is the one derived column: setup WNS divided by the target
period.  A routed record with large headroom was constrained so loosely that
the router and repair_design had no reason to work, so its Fmax reports where
the tool stopped, not where the design stops -- that is why the same block can
appear twice at very different frequencies.

records.fmax_basis: 1 / (target clock period - setup WNS) at this target period.  Note the SDC derives input/output delay as 20% of the clock period, so for an I/O-bounded path this quantity varies with the target period; use fmax_search for a period-independent figure.
